candidateIdentity.variantName: Orient Bambino 38mm, white dial, black leather strap

sourceChecks.note: Orient's exact global product page independently validates identity, fixed black-leather configuration, 38.4 x 12.5 x 44 mm geometry, 20 mm lug width, 54 g full weight, F6724 automatic/manual-winding movement, -15/+25 seconds per day, more than 40 hours of reserve, 30 m water resistance, mineral crystal, pin buckle, and date. Its explicit Luminous Light row is blank, supporting no lume rather than an inferred performance grade.
Orient's exact official U.K. page independently validates the £294.99 GBP new-product offer, current out-of-stock state, identity, geometry, movement, materials, 30 m rating, and date at 3 o'clock.

Orient's official U.S. page for the same base reference corroborates the physical configuration, movement, geometry, water resistance, date, push-pull crown, leather strap, and traditional pin buckle. Pin buckle describes the clasp and does not resolve the strap-to-case interface.

Orient's official service guidance documents the standard spring-bar construction used to secure conventional leather straps between the lugs. This establishes the manufacturer's interface terminology but is not used alone as exact-reference evidence.

The specialist strap maker's exact-reference RA-AC0M03S fitment guide states that every recommended strap was tested on the watch, documents the standard 20 mm lug interface, gives spring-bar removal and installation steps, and distinguishes the factory standard spring bars from replacement quick-release spring bars. Together with Orient's exact product dimensions and manufacturer service terminology, this resolves the attachment as spring_bar without inferring it from leather material or buckle type.
